title: Rethinking Energy -- 100% Solar, Wind and Batteries Is Just The Beginning
summary: Tony Seba of RethinkX presents the case that solar, wind and batteries are on a cost-decline path that makes a fully renewable grid achievable. It was made for the Global 100% RE Strategy Group's joint declaration.
why: HN cites it as support for the argument that renewables with storage are already cheapest and still getting cheaper.
